cases.name: untyped variable-length self-loop returns exactly the 24 nodes that lie on a cycle and excludes the 2 acyclic decoy nodes
untyped variable-length self-loop filtered to the acyclic decoy nodes (p, q, reachable from a but never returning) yields no rows
untyped self-loop for node a returns exactly its 1-hop self-edge path a->a and not the a->p decoy branch
cases.cypher: match p = (n)-[*..]->(n) where n.name = 'a' return p

cases.name: untyped self-loop for node b returns exactly one 2-hop cycle path b->c->b over two EdgeKind1 edges
cases.cypher: match p = (n)-[*..]->(n) where n.name = 'b' return p

cases.name: untyped self-loop for node d returns exactly one 3-hop cycle path d->e->f->d over three EdgeKind1 edges
cases.cypher: match p = (n)-[*..]->(n) where n.name = 'd' return p

cases.name: untyped self-loop filtered to the self4 group returns exactly its 4 member nodes g, h, i, j
untyped self-loop filtered to the mixed-kind self3mix group returns all 3 members r, s, t (the cycle closes only by crossing edge kinds)
untyped self-loop for node r returns exactly one 3-hop path r->s->t->r whose edges span EdgeKind1, EdgeKind2, EdgeKind1
cases.cypher: match p = (n)-[*..]->(n) where n.name = 'r' return p

cases.name: EdgeKind1-typed self-loop returns exactly the 19 nodes on all-EdgeKind1 cycles, excluding the mixed-kind and EdgeKind2-only cycles
EdgeKind1-typed self-loop filtered to the mixed-kind self3mix group yields no rows (the cycle cannot close using EdgeKind1 alone)
EdgeKind1-typed self-loop filtered to the EdgeKind2-only self2k2 group yields no rows
EdgeKind2-typed self-loop returns exactly the 2 nodes u, v of the only EdgeKind2-only cycle
EdgeKind2-typed self-loop for node u returns exactly one 2-hop path u->v->u over two EdgeKind2 edges
cases.cypher: match p = (n)-[:EdgeKind2*..]->(n) where n.name = 'u' return p

cases.name: fixed-length (a)-[:EdgeKind1]->(b)-[:EdgeKind1]->(a) with limit 100 returns all 6 two-hop EdgeKind1 round-trip paths
fixed-length untyped (a)-[]->(b)-[]->(a) with limit 100 returns all 8 two-hop round-trip endpoint pairs
